title: LIME: Learning Intent-aware Camera Motion from Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2607.02417v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous robots often need to move their camera before they can act: to inspect an object, reveal an occluded region, or obtain a view that responds to a user's intent. While vision-language navigation translates instructions to base motion and vision-language-action policies map instructions to manipulation actions, vision-language conditioned camera motion remains comparatively underexplored as a first-class action. We formulate vision-language conditioned camera motion generation: given a current RGB observation and a free-form natural-language intent, predict a relative target camera pose for the next observation. The challenge is that useful viewpoint changes depend on latent perceptual intent, ranging from coarse spatial moves to fine-grained inspection or occlusion revealing. To model this structure, we mine multi-intent camera-motion supervision from egocentric video via hindsight labeling, pairing each relative SE(3)

translated_title: LIME：从自我中心视频学习意图感知的相机运动
translated_abstract: 自主机器人通常需要先移动相机才能执行动作：例如检查物体、揭示被遮挡的区域，或获得能够响应用户意图的视角。虽然视觉-语言导航将指令转化为底盘运动，视觉-语言-动作策略将指令映射到操作动作，但视觉-语言条件下的相机运动作为一类独立的动作仍相对缺乏研究。我们提出了视觉-语言条件下的相机运动生成任务：给定当前的RGB观测和自由形式的自然语言意图，预测下一次观测的相对目标相机位姿。其挑战在于，有用的视角变化依赖于潜在的感知意图，涵盖从粗粒度的空间移动到细粒度的物体检查或遮挡揭示。为了建模这种结构，我们通过事后标注从自我中心视频中挖掘多意图的相机运动监督数据，将每个相对SE(3)……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次将视觉-语言条件下的相机运动生成形式化为独立任务，并提出通过事后标注从自我中心视频中挖掘多意图监督数据的方法，使机器人能够根据自然语言意图预测相机运动。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates vision-language conditioned camera motion generation as a first-class action and mines multi-intent supervision from egocentric video via hindsight labeling, enabling robots to predict camera motion from free-form natural-language intents.
